notes.subject: בשלכת
notes.rationale: Felling of trees (ASV/JPS/BSB) vs casting leaves (KJV 'when they cast their leaves'); the root שלכ supports both.

notes.subject: מצבת
notes.rationale: 'Stump/stock' (monumental stone or tree stock) vs KJV 'substance'; the same rare word opens and closes the verse.

notes.subject: מצבת ... מצבתה
notes.rationale: Inclusion: the verse begins and ends with the same word pair, stamp — stamp bilong em, framing the remnant theme.

notes.subject: pikinini holi
notes.rationale: The remnant is sealed in a riddling tree-felling image; the holy seed is hidden in the stump.

translation: Na yet long ⟨em⟩ i stap wanpela ten hap, na ⟨em⟩ i kam bek, na bai ⟨em⟩ i kamap olsem samting ol i kukim long paia: olsem diwai terebin na olsem diwai aok we, taim ol i paitim ol i go daun, stamp i stap yet namel long ol — pikinini holi, em i stamp bilong ⟨em⟩.

tokens.gloss: taim ol i paitim i go daun
